evidence: In the present experiments (1 0 0) oriented GaAs substrates have been used in a zinc chloride and hydrogen sulphide-based procedure performed in a "Microchemistry" F-120 reactor. The process has been led under the same conditions, as applied already for the wurtzite film growth [-2], that is 3600 cycles at the temperature of ZnCI2 370°C and of the substrate 510°C.
